summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for the NSE, BSE, and MCX Real-Time Market Monitoring Dashboard. Covers client-side E2EE WebCrypto authentication for seamless GitHub deployment, multi-segment market data engine (Indices, Equities, F&O option chains, MCX commodities), technical pattern alerts, India VIX volatility models, macroeconomic trackers, multi-language support (EN, HI, GU, MR, TA), automated PDF institutional reporting, and offline IndexedDB caching.
